## Before you file

- Granary is an **unofficial, community-maintained fork** of MinIO. It is not
  affiliated with or endorsed by MinIO, Inc. Do not report Granary issues to
  upstream MinIO channels, and do not report upstream MinIO issues here.
- **Security issues**: do not open a public issue. Use
  [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/relvo-labs/granary/security/advisories/new)
  as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/relvo-labs/granary/blob/master/SECURITY.md).
- Granary has no published releases yet. Build from source as described in the
  [README](https://github.com/relvo-labs/granary#build-and-try-locally) and
  report the exact commit you built.
- Issues are handled on a best-effort basis; there is no support SLA.
- Use synthetic data. Do not paste credentials, personal data or real host
  details.
